title: Show HN: An e-ink frame that hears birds and draws them as 1800s illustrations
summary: A creative hardware project that uses an e-ink display frame to detect bird sounds via audio recognition and generates 1800s-style illustrations of the detected birds, creating a unique blend of nature observation and vintage artistic visualization.
problem_solved: Transforms ambient bird sounds into beautiful, nostalgic 1800s-style artwork displayed on an e-ink frame.
why_valuable: Combines hardware, audio AI, and generative art into a charming home decor piece that bridges nature and technology in a whimsical way.
